title: Eliminate Vite dynamic import warnings, double frontend build, and static VCRuntime compiler warning
commitMessage: fix(build): eliminate Vite dynamic import warnings, static VC runtime warning, and double build
author: agent-developer (Lead Subagent, Level 1)
summary: Resolved three build pipeline issues: (1) Replaced dynamic imports of boardStore in cortexStore and drawerStore in boardStore with static imports to eliminate Vite chunking warnings; (2) Configured beforeBuildCommand in tauri.conf.json to use pnpm build and passed --no-before-build to tauri build in build-release.bat and build-release.ps1 to prevent redundant frontend builds; (3) Added staticVCRuntime under build.windows in tauri.conf.json and simplified src-tauri/build.rs to eliminate Rust compiler deprecation warning.
